The flags and environment variables the DSL artifacts name: the gates on tool kinds and DSL features, and the limits a worker reads. It is **not** every environment variable the server and worker read; only those the artifacts publish.

## Gates

> every catalog flag is OFF by default (each is strict "true", read once per process); with a flag off the server behaves as if the feature did not exist

| Variable | Read by | What it enables | Default | Requires |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NOETL_AGENT_CALLBACK_ORIGINS` | server | allowed callback origins for `metadata.expose.agent` |  |  |
| `NOETL_AGENT_ENDPOINT` | server | serves `metadata.expose.agent`: GET /api/agents, GET /api/agents/cards/{path}, POST /api/agents/send, GET /api/agents/tasks/{id} | off |  |
| `NOETL_CATALOG_CAS` | server | catalog: content_addressing: digest on register, dedup, /api/catalog/{resolve,blob,sources,pin} | off |  |
| `NOETL_CATALOG_DISCOVERY` | server | catalog: discovery: POST /api/catalog/peer/resolve (signed, trusted peers only), POST /api/catalog/locate (internal token); imports under peer/<instance>/<path> | off | `NOETL_CATALOG_CAS`, `NOETL_INSTANCE_REGISTRY`, `NOETL_CATALOG_PEER_KEY_FILE` |
| `NOETL_CATALOG_HOT_RELOAD` | server | serves `metadata.catalog.hot_reload`: an explicit `@latest` sub-playbook reference inside this root's pinned execution tree | off | `NOETL_CATALOG_PINNING`, `NOETL_CATALOG_CAS` |
| `NOETL_CATALOG_PINNING` | server | catalog: execution_pinning: POST /api/execute `version` (a positive integer or "latest") and `digest` (sha256:, wins over version) are honoured, and `path` may be a reference form. A `kind: playbook` step sends `version` as an integer only, so it asks for @latest or a digest through its `path`. A child of a pinned execution with no version resolves to the root's pinned version. With the flag off, version/digest are ignored and the path resolves to its latest version | off | `NOETL_CATALOG_CAS` |
| `NOETL_CATALOG_REMOTE_CALLS` | server | catalog: remote_execution: inside a pinned tree a remote reference resolves to what the ROOT first got for it, in both modes, even if the owner registers a new version mid-run; a child of an imported playbook resolves bare names on its home instance (peer/<instance>/<name>). With the flag off `remote: delegate` is refused by name and nothing else changes | off | `NOETL_CATALOG_PINNING`, `NOETL_CATALOG_CAS` |
| `NOETL_CATALOG_URI_FETCH` | server | catalog: uri_fetch: locate fetches a reference's own source URI; fail closed, nothing is fetched without an allowlist | off | `NOETL_CATALOG_DISCOVERY`, `NOETL_CATALOG_URI_ALLOW` |
| `NOETL_MCP_SERVER` | server | serves `metadata.expose.mcp`: POST /api/mcp (one MCP tool per exposed playbook) | off |  |
| `NOETL_TOOL_KIND_AGENT` | server | enables `kind: agent` | off |  |
| `NOETL_TOOL_KIND_MCP` | server | enables `kind: mcp` | off |  |
| `NOETL_WORKER_AGENT_TOOL` | worker | lets a worker run `kind: agent` | off |  |

## Limits

| Variable | Default | Unit | Note | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NOETL_AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS` | 32 (DEFAULT) | tool calls per agent step | positive integers only; the model cannot raise it; exceeding it ends the step with agent.final refused: tool_call_budget | noetl/worker@d1c9584 src/executor/agent_host.rs:50 |
| `NOETL_AGENT_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECS` | 180 (DEFAULT) | s per playbook-bound child |  | noetl/worker@d1c9584 src/executor/agent_host.rs:51 |
| `NOETL_COMMAND_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES` | 524288 (DEFAULT) | bytes | a command context above it is offloaded as a __context_ref__ | noetl/server src/config/app.rs:242-246 |
| `NOETL_EVENT_EMIT_OUTAGE_BUDGET_SECS` | 120 (DEFAULT) | s | extra retry window for event emits during a server outage; the slot stays held | noetl/worker@d1c9584 src/client/control_plane.rs:125, 133-140 |
| `NOETL_EVENT_RESULT_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES` | 102400 (DEFAULT) | bytes | a step result above it is spilled to the result store and replaced by a reference: a downstream read then costs a fetch | noetl/worker@d1c9584 src/executor/command.rs:1843, 1857-1865 |
| `NOETL_RECONCILE_MAX_NOOPS` | 225 (DEFAULT) | consecutive no-progress polls at an 8 s tick (~30 min) | how long a stuck execution is re-driven before the server stops | noetl/server src/config/app.rs:702-726 |
| `NOETL_WASM_FUEL` | 10000000000 (DEFAULT) | fuel units per invocation | 0 / off / none / unlimited removes the limit; an unparseable value keeps the default; a trip increments noetl_worker_plugin_limit_trips_total{limit} | noetl/worker@d1c9584 src/plugin.rs:41 |
| `NOETL_WASM_MAX_MEMORY_MB` | 1024 (DEFAULT) | MiB linear memory |  | noetl/worker@d1c9584 src/plugin.rs:47 |
| `NOETL_WASM_TIMEOUT_MS` | 30000 (DEFAULT) | ms wall clock per invocation | 10 ms deadline granularity | noetl/worker@d1c9584 src/plugin.rs:44 |
| `NOETL_WORKER_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_SECS` | 150 (DEFAULT) | s | on SIGTERM a worker finishes in-flight commands within this budget | noetl/worker@d1c9584 src/worker.rs:1139 |
| `WORKER_MAX_CONCURRENT` | 4 (DEFAULT) | slots per worker process |  | noetl/worker@d1c9584 src/config.rs:115-118 |

## Agent budgets

| Variable | Default | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| `NOETL_AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS` | 32 | tool calls per agent step |
| `NOETL_AGENT_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECS` | 180 | seconds per playbook-bound child |
